name: sim_szilard_axis3_phase_reset_bridge
claim: Szilard memory erasure (Landauer reset) is a phase reset in Axis 3 (phase / fiber coordinate). The memory state (|0> or |1> after measurement) is returned to |0> = fixed reference phase. The entropy cost of erasure = k_B * H(prior) = the phase information destroyed. The Axis 3 fiber collapses from two values to one (trivial fiber) during erasure. Clifford rotor R(phi) represents the phase; phase reset = R -> 1 = inverse rotation by -phi.

pytorch.reason: represent memory state as probability distribution p(0),p(1); compute H(p) = -p log p - (1-p) log(1-p); after erasure p -> (1,0); verify deltaH = H_before - H_after = k_B*ln(2)*p(1); load-bearing

pyg.reason: no graph learning required; probe operates on density matrices not graph structures

z3.reason: UNSAT: erase AND total entropy change = 0 (erasing info without entropy cost violates Landauer — UNSAT); load-bearing

cvc5.reason: z3 sufficient for all separability and product-form UNSAT proofs in this sim

sympy.reason: symbolic Landauer: deltaS = k_B * H(p) (Shannon entropy of prior = cost of erasure); verify dS/d(p1) = k_B*ln(2) at p1=0.5 (maximum cost); load-bearing

clifford.reason: Cl(2,0) rotor R = cos(phi)+sin(phi)*e12 represents phase; phase reset = R -> 1 = rotating by -phi; cost = arc length |phi|; load-bearing

geomstats.reason: no Riemannian manifold computation required; geometry handled analytically

e3nn.reason: no SO(3)-equivariant neural network computation required in this probe

rustworkx.reason: Szilard/erasure graph: measure -> {|0>,|1>} -> erase -> reset_state; erasure node in-degree=2, out-degree=1; load-bearing

xgi.reason: triple hyperedge {erasure, Axis3, Landauer_cost}: 3-way phenomenon; load-bearing

toponetx.reason: no chain complex or cell complex computation required in this probe

gudhi.reason: no persistent homology or Rips complex computation required in this probe

P1_two_distinct_memory_phases.note: Before erasure: |0> = phase 0, |1> = phase pi; two distinct Axis 3 fiber coordinates

P2_erasure_phase_reset_to_zero.note: After erasure: memory always in |0> = phase 0; Axis 3 fiber collapsed to single point

P3_entropy_cost_uniform_prior.note: Uniform prior (max uncertainty): erasure cost = k_B*ln(2) = one bit of entropy

P4_fiber_collapse_trivial.note: Erasure collapses fiber from 2 values to 1: Axis 3 fiber becomes trivial

P5_clifford_phase_reset_cost.note: Clifford phase reset: cost=0 at phi=0 (trivial); cost=2 at phi=pi (maximum)

P6_pytorch_entropy_at_uniform.note: H(0.5) = ln(2); dH/dp1 = 0 at uniform prior (maximum entropy = maximum Axis 3 cost)

P7_sympy_erasure_cost_derivative.note: dS/dp1 = 0 at p1=0.5 (maximum erasure cost at uniform prior); symbolic confirmation

P8_rustworkx_szilard_erasure_graph.note: Erasure node: in-degree=2 (from |0> and |1>); out-degree=1 (to reset_state)

P9_xgi_triple_hyperedge.note: {erasure, Axis3, Landauer_cost} is a 3-way hyperedge: all three are coupled

P10_erasure_cost_proportional_to_prior_e.note: Erasure cost = k_B*H(prior): maximum at p1=0.5 (uniform, maximum Axis 3 displacement)

N1_z3_erasure_without_entropy_unsat.note: UNSAT: erasure with zero entropy AND dS >= 0.001 (Landauer floor) simultaneously

N2_erasure_without_measurement_full_cost.note: Without measurement: full Landauer cost; after measurement of |0>: zero extra cost

N3_clifford_zero_phase_reset_cost.note: Phase=0 rotor is already at reset target: cost=0; Axis 3 displacement=0

N4_sympy_pure_state_zero_erasure_cost.note: Pure prior states (p1=0 or p1=1): erasure cost = 0 (no Axis 3 phase information to destroy)

N5_pytorch_entropy_drop_after_erasure.note: Erasure drops entropy by ~k_B*ln(2): the Axis 3 phase information cost is real

B1_phi_zero_zero_cost.note: At phi=0 (already in |0>): erasure cost = 0; Axis 3 is already trivial

B2_phi_pi_maximum_arc_cost.note: At phi=pi (maximally different from |0>): arc cost = pi (maximum Axis 3 displacement)

B3_clifford_rotor_times_inverse_is_one.note: R(phi) * R(-phi) = 1: phase reset is the inverse rotation; R R^{-1} = identity

B4_rustworkx_szilard_erasure_is_dag.note: Single-shot Szilard erasure is a DAG: measure->branch->erase->reset (no cycles)

B5_xgi_Axis3_node_degree_one.note: Axis3 node has degree=1: appears only in the erasure/Landauer hyperedge
